# `pasmo`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from the assembler's own declared surface. Edits here are overwritten; change the declaration instead. -->

Z80, pasmo syntax.

## Directives

11 directives, 18 spellings. This is the list the parser looks a word up in, so a spelling here is one the assembler accepts and a spelling missing from it is one it refuses.

| Directive | Spellings | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `bytes` | `defb`, `db`, `defm`, `dm` |  |
| `conditional` | `if`, `else`, `endif` |  |
| `end` | `end` |  |
| `equ` | `equ` |  |
| `incbin` | `incbin` |  |
| `include` | `include` | Recognised, and not implemented |
| `macro` | `macro` |  |
| `org` | `org` |  |
| `repeat` | `rept` |  |
| `reserve` | `defs`, `ds` |  |
| `words` | `defw`, `dw` |  |

Instruction mnemonics are not listed here — they come from the instruction-set spec and have their own reference.

## Projects in more than one file

This dialect has no include directive yet, so a project in more than one file does not assemble. It is the one front door where that is true — see [Projects in more than one file](../../guide/multi-file.md).
